rv.q: It’s well worth catching whether you’re a fan of the book or new to it.
Despite being highly stylized, and some might say overproduced, this production's elements all come together to create an utterly disturbing and authentic stage retelling.

cn.t: This adaptation earns praise as a masterpiece for its fresh, intelligent approach to Orwell's complex novel, with directors finding innovative ways to bring the dystopian classic's themes to vivid theatrical life.
